name: Vigil helm library 0.3 (VH4)
revision: 0.3 · 18 helms: every design from 0.1 and 0.2 in one print-safe library, crisp edges, no voxel terracing
description: The Vigil helm library 0.3 (VH4) brings every helm design of the line into one print-safe set on the same 1.6 mm D-flat neck peg. Carried from 0.2 (VH3) and cleaned: VH4-03 Plummet (drop trooper), VH4-04 Sightline (recon, side optic pod), VH4-05 Ironclad (heavy assault, portcullis faceplate), VH4-10 Stillwater (sealed void globe), VH4-13 Herald (officer, fin and comm mast), VH4-14 Longsight (sniper, sallet tail and monocular), VH4-15 Deckhand (open-face crew), VH4-18 Grimward (scarred veteran, death's-head faceplate). Re-sculpted from 0.1 and the unbuilt VH2 set: VH4-01 Lineguard (the line standard: gull-wing split visor, keel crest, cheek vents, aural hoses, lamp), VH4-02 Marshal (sergeant: swept blade crest, command antenna, rank bars), VH4-06 Breacher (armoured faceplate, slit lens, blast ribs, rivets), VH4-07 Sentinel (T-visor under a heavy brow, ribbed jaw), VH4-08 Raptor (faceted beak, slanted lenses, swept fin), VH4-09 Diver (round faceport with bolts, breather cans, collar), VH4-11 Hunter (tall helm, three lens slits, mandible guards, sensor spine), VH4-12 Specter (scout under a hood, monocular, filter snout), VH4-16 Mender (medic: paint channels, triage scanner, filters), VH4-17 Wright (engineer: flip-up goggles, headlamp, tool port). Glass is a separate recessed surface on every helm for painting.
buildNotes: Defined in tools/helms04.py (VH4 registry: the eight VH3 helms plus ten re-sculpted from 0.1 and VH2 on the tools/helms3.py building blocks); built on a 0.05 mm grid, print meshes not simplified or decimated.
Print safety by tools/morph.py print_safe_selective: only walls under 0.42 mm and slots under 0.5 mm are changed, so edges stay crisp and faces carry no voxel terracing.
Every helm checked with unified-CAD-MCP miniature_printability_check (print pose from miniature_support_plan) and miniature_detail_resolution_check; see reports/printability.md and DESIGN-LOG.md.
Display sheets colour the glass from each helm's own glass masks; the print files are one solid each.
limitations: Procedural sculpt at about 6 mm helm width: faces are stylised. No STEP reference in the package (STLs are the print files). Printability is a heuristic screen (unified-CAD-MCP), not a test print.

mini.process: MSLA resin · 8K 7-inch class MSLA (e.g. Elegoo Saturn/Mars class)

printability.summary: 18 print files checked upright as modelled; no fail-severity findings and no recesses that fill in. Support plans not yet run.
issues: Advisory: 1-8 marginal recesses (0.3-0.4 mm) per helm
